verdict.rationale: Daytona's pricing page explicitly states $200 in free compute is included and emphasizes usage-based, self-serve access ('use what you need, when you need it') with no mention of required sales contact; the open-source repo is also free to use. Missing for 10: independent confirmation of the sign-up flow (e.g., no-credit-card requirement) and details on free-tier limits/expiration.
